comparators.reconstruction: the median |1h return| and one 0.1 USDT tick, in bp

decisions.grid_rule: hours whose count since 2020-01-01T00:00Z is divisible by 25
decisions.rule: D from 2020-01-22T08:00Z (the first full context) to 2024-06-07T08:00Z (TRAINING_END - 48 h) inclusive

encoding.reconstruction: tokenizer.decode([s1, s2], half=True); xr = zr * (std + 1e-5) + mean with the inference statistics, float32 (K:657)
encoding.z_pre: post_quant_embed_pre of the s1 bits of indices_to_bits, every decoder layer, head (the forward pass's z_pre, K:98-106)

flag_reading: point estimates of the real sources against the thresholds; descriptive, no automatic action

price_saturation_context.rule: a price channel's share of context entries with |z| > 5 above 0.1 %

price_saturation_next.rule: a price channel's share of next rows (row 512, inference statistics) beyond +-5 above 1 % (Part A)

r1_token_mismatch.rule: R1's context-token mismatch above 5 % (Part A): the share of the 512 context rows whose s1 or s2 token differs from the inference encoding, which bounds the s1 share, the s2 share and their mean; the owner is told before the pre-registration bundle (D-048 (5))

s1_unused_share.rule: more than half the s1 codes unused

volume_amount_saturation.rule: the volume or amount share of context entries with |z| > 5 above 1 %

intervals.descriptive: p90, p99, maxima, comparators, codebook statistics, divergences

shares.rule: share=True only for these per-window 0/1 indicators (deff and n_eff against windows; a share of exactly 0 or 1 gets a Wilson interval at the block count); every other statistic, the per-window fractions of entries, coordinates or rows included (saturation_context, bit_margin, mismatch), is a mean with share=False

normalisation.formula: (x - mean) / (std + 1e-5), population std, x float32; the statistics reduced on a Fortran-ordered float32 copy of the rows they average over

reference.blocks: one (no decision hour): point estimates only

statistics.bit_margin_<t>: share of the L2-normalised latent coordinates with |z| < t
statistics.close_error_median_abs_bp: median over windows and rows of |1e4 (xr - x) / x| of the close (x the float32 context); p90, p99 and max descriptive
statistics.codebook: distinct s1, s2 codes and (s1, s2) pairs, also at matched row counts (M = the smallest compared set's rows, rows in time order at np.linspace(0, n - 1, M).round()); entropy (natural log), perplexity, normalised entropy (entropy / log(2 ** bits)); the fewest s1 codes covering 50, 90 and 99 % of rows; per-bit share of ones (dead below 1 % or above 99 %); all descriptive
statistics.comparators: median |1h return| in bp, one 0.1 USDT tick in bp (median over windows of 1e4 * 0.1 / last close), P(|N(0,1)| > 5) = 5.733e-7
statistics.js_first_second_half: Jensen-Shannon divergence (log base 2) of the s1 marginals of the first and the second half of the windows (comparator)
statistics.mismatch_<variant>_<s1|s2|any>[_last24]: per window, the share of the 512 context rows (and of the last 24) whose s1 token, s2 token, or either of the two (any: the context tokens of D-048 (5)) under the variant's normalisation differs from the inference encoding; the window encodes all its rows (the encoder is causal, M:345-350), the first 512 positions compared; context_only must give exactly 0 (a positive control)
statistics.pre_<statistic>: the same for z_pre, the reconstruction from the s1 bits alone
statistics.rho: median |er| / median |r| with r_j = log(close_j / close_(j-1)), j = 1..511, and er_j the same on xr minus r_j (returns of a non-positive reconstructed close dropped and counted); a ratio computed per resample
statistics.rmse_<channel>, rmse_last24_<channel>: sqrt of the mean of (zr - zc)^2 over every context row and over the last 24 (normalised space)
statistics.saturation_context_<channel>: share of context entries with |z| > 5 (inference statistics); mean of the per-window shares (equal rows per window)
statistics.saturation_next_<channel>: share of windows whose row 512 (inference statistics) lies beyond +-5
statistics.saturation_windows_<channel>: share of windows with at least one context entry with |z| > 5

window.incomplete: a window with a missing candle is dropped and listed with its ranges
